svg.title: Trainer Dashboard Architecture Diagram
svg.desc: Three-layer architecture: OneDrive Excel as data source, FastAPI backend in the middle, React frontend for users

g.onclick: sendPrompt('How does Microsoft Graph API connect to OneDrive Excel?')
sendPrompt('What is Microsoft Graph API and how does it work?')
sendPrompt('What is Azure App Registration and why is it needed?')
sendPrompt('How does the Graph API connector fetch Excel data in Python?')
sendPrompt('How does data parsing work for the wide date-grid CSV format?')
sendPrompt('What REST API endpoints will the backend expose?')
sendPrompt('What does the trainer availability view look like?')
sendPrompt('What does the delivery pipeline status view show?')
sendPrompt('What KPI metrics will the summary cards show?')
sendPrompt('How does conflict detection work for double-booked trainers?')
